consensus_strengths: The paper clearly specifies a receipt-bound ownership contract for hybrid KV and recurrent GDN state, including phase-aware storage predicates and pointer-free interval rules.
The 2x2 ownership factorial, explicit evidence tiers, selected independent attention/GDN checks, and careful memory denominators support a coherent bounded case study.

Claim boundaries are unusually disciplined: the paper explicitly excludes independent producer recapture, end-to-end validation, compiled-dispatch identity, concurrency, capacity, and detector-rate claims.
The PDF is professionally structured and readable, with explicit cohort authorization, limitations, ethics statement, and reproducibility statement.
consensus_weaknesses: The central lifecycle and equality evidence is conditional on trusted producer capture; compiled-binary and autotuning provenance remain explicitly partial, while independent numerical corroboration is sampled rather than end-to-end.
The contribution is a useful but narrow integration of established auditing, metamorphic-testing, cache-management, and accounting ideas, validated on one sequential Qwen/H20 stack.
Targeted mutations establish intended-gate reachability, not detection effectiveness against held-out or natural faults.
The method is dense: its minimal normative workflow, evidence hierarchy, and distinction between primary evidence and unpooled context are spread across many tables and appendices.

positions: R26-TERRA-A assigns 4, viewing trusted capture, limited validation, and modest novelty as marginally below the bar.
R26-TERRA-B and R26-TERRA-C assign 6, emphasizing that the narrow limitations are candidly stated and that the scoped ownership witness is technically useful.
material_disagreements.recommended_resolution: Score the paper as 6: the stated, narrow receipt-level claim is supported well enough for a marginally positive assessment, but the same limitations cap its current significance and evidence strength.

material_disagreements.topic: Whether broader scheduling and cross-runtime experiments are required
positions: R26-TERRA-A and R26-TERRA-C treat concurrent/continuous-batching and broader-runtime evaluation as major required fixes.
R26-TERRA-B permits the alternative of retaining a clearly narrowed one-stack case-study framing.
material_disagreements.recommended_resolution: The PDF already makes the latter framing explicit in its title, abstract, protocol, and limitations. Broader scheduling/runtime evaluation is needed to support broader impact or transfer claims, but its absence is not a defect in the explicitly sequential, one-stack claim.

positions: R26-TERRA-A and R26-TERRA-B describe executable artifacts, ledgers, and raw records as absent from the visible submission.
The PDF identifies an accompanying package, manifest, replay commands, and record locations, but the package itself was outside the permitted review inputs.
material_disagreements.recommended_resolution: Do not infer artifact absence or inaccessibility from PDF-only review. The accessible PDF supports only the stated artifact plan; an artifact check or independent replay would be new evidence, not a finding that the artifact is absent.

positions: R26-TERRA-A and R26-TERRA-B rate presentation 3 because the paper is dense and repetitive.
R26-TERRA-C rates presentation 4 because its figures, tables, caveats, and evidence distinctions are unusually clear.
material_disagreements.recommended_resolution: Treat presentation as good rather than excellent: the paper is careful and legible, but a concise normative core and sharper evidence-status summary would materially improve evaluability.

unsupported_reviewer_claims.reason: The PDF cannot establish that the referenced replay package, manifests, raw records, or executable implementation are actually absent. It identifies an accompanying package and relative paths; PDF-only review can establish neither their availability nor their completeness.

The observation that the PDF alone is not executable is valid, but it does not support a claim that the advertised artifact is absent or inaccessible. Artifact availability requires inspection outside the permitted inputs.

The described lack of concurrent, continuous-batching, and cross-runtime evidence is supported, but treating it as a validity defect overlooks the paper's explicit sequential one-stack scope. It limits transfer and significance rather than contradicting the claimed case-study result.

A held-out fault corpus would substantiate a broader diagnostic-effectiveness claim, but the PDF explicitly presents the nine mutations only as intended-gate positive controls and disclaims detector-rate or completeness claims.

prioritized_actions.description: Add a compact normative workflow in the main paper: mandatory record classes, seven target predicates, trust assumptions, what counts as receipt-complete versus partial, and the minimal adoption steps for a new sequential hybrid runtime. Keep detailed cohort tables in the appendix.
prioritized_actions.verification_criterion: A reader can identify the required records, decision rule, evidence tiers, and nonclaims from one self-contained method summary.

prioritized_actions.description: Make the headline and concluding claim consistently describe the result as trusted-producer receipt-level ownership evidence for one sequential stack, and place the partial dispatch status beside the main result summary.
prioritized_actions.verification_criterion: No abstract, conclusion, figure caption, or result sentence can reasonably be read as claiming independent recapture, compiled-dispatch verification, end-to-end correctness, or production-serving validation.

prioritized_actions.description: Strengthen assurance with an independently implemented capture/observer for the primary factorial and bind each relevant call to compiled-binary and autotuning provenance. Compare observer predicates with the producer ledger and retain mismatches as failures.
prioritized_actions.verification_criterion: A clean observer agrees with the producer on lifecycle/storage facts for the factorial and detects deliberately altered dispatch provenance while preserving the Python-level callable.

prioritized_actions.description: If claiming diagnostic effectiveness beyond positive controls, evaluate against a preregistered held-out realistic-fault corpus and output-equality, lifecycle-invariant, and differential/metamorphic baselines.
prioritized_actions.verification_criterion: Report the complete pre-specified detection, localization, false-positive, and escape matrix, including failures, for every method and fault.

prioritized_actions.description: Only if broadening the paper beyond its current sequential case-study scope, transfer the contract to an independent hybrid runtime and concurrent or continuous-batching execution with varied lifecycle conditions.
prioritized_actions.verification_criterion: Report unchanged and changed contract predicates, observer results, and failures across the added runtime and scheduling regimes without pooling those cohorts with the original factorial.

decision_rationale: The strongest verified contribution is a precise, replay-oriented ownership specification and scoped 2x2 witness for a hybrid sequential stack. Its soundness is good for that conditional scope: lifecycle/storage predicates, relational comparisons, selected operator checks, and caveats are technically coherent. Presentation is good but overly dense, and contribution is useful yet modest because the ingredients are established and validation is intentionally narrow. Trusted producer capture, incomplete dispatch binding, selected rather than end-to-end numerical checks, and targeted rather than held-out faults prevent a higher score under current evidence. These limitations constrain assurance and significance but do not invalidate the carefully stated receipt-level claim; broader scheduling and runtime coverage would be expansion evidence rather than a prerequisite for that narrow claim.
